title: Jubilant Crunchy Mediterranean Kale Salad
description: A bitter yet comforting Mediterranean salad featuring crunchy kale, fresh veggies, feta, and a glossy peach glaze.

ingredients.name: peach glaze
ingredients.notes: made by reducing peach juice with olive oil, mustard, and vinegar

instructions: Wash and stem the kale, then chop into bite-size pieces.
Dice the cucumber, julienne the carrots, dice the red bell pepper, and halve the cherry tomatoes.
In a large bowl, combine the kale, cucumber, carrots, bell pepper, and tomatoes.
Add the pumpkin seeds, crumbled feta cheese, sliced olives, and chopped oregano to the bowl.
Season the salad with sea salt and black pepper, then gently toss to mix.

To make the peach glaze, whisk together 3 tbsp peach juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, and 1 tsp apple cider vinegar, then heat the mixture in a small saucepan over medium heat until it reduces to a glossy consistency.
Pour the hot glaze over the salad and toss until the leaves are evenly coated.
Serve immediately, or chill for 10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
